'''Sliver''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> vendor alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, Sliver lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where they worked in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as the [[Poison Pit]] within [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> an industrial town controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> Sliver's job was to sell tokens for the cantina's [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]], with each token costing 125 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The tokens allowed patrons of the cantina to choose what song the jukebox would play next from a short list of available tracks. Sliver wore a [[Color/Legends|brown]] tunic and pants while working at the cantina and had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sliver first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game Sliver appeared on Nal Hutta, which was the starting planet for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]]. They sold jukebox tokens to players which could be used when interacting with jukeboxes throughout the game to allow players to choose which song played next.<ref name="SWTOR" />
